# IronClaw

## Docs

###  

- [Introduction](https://docs.ironclaw.com/index.md): The secure, open-source AI agent
- [Quickstart](https://docs.ironclaw.com/quickstart.md): Create your first Agent in minutes
- [Onboard](https://docs.ironclaw.com/onboard.md): Initialize your agent's home directory and first-run settings

### Using IronClaw

- [Web Interface](https://docs.ironclaw.com/using/webui.md): Chat with your agent and manage it from the browser
- [CLI Reference](https://docs.ironclaw.com/using/cli.md): Every command the ironclaw binary provides
- [Run as a Service](https://docs.ironclaw.com/using/service.md): Keep IronClaw running in the background

### Capabilities

- [Capabilities Overview](https://docs.ironclaw.com/capabilities/overview.md): Discover what makes IronClaw unique
- [Inference Providers](https://docs.ironclaw.com/capabilities/llm-providers.md): IronClaw readily supports multiple LLM providers

#### Core Capabilities

- [Security](https://docs.ironclaw.com/security.md): IronClaw's defense-in-depth security architecture
- [Storage](https://docs.ironclaw.com/capabilities/database.md): Where IronClaw keeps its data, and when to move to PostgreSQL
- [Configuration](https://docs.ironclaw.com/capabilities/configuration.md): How IronClaw is configured and where each setting lives
- [Skills](https://docs.ironclaw.com/capabilities/skills.md): Prompt extensions that activate based on context
- [WASM Tools](https://docs.ironclaw.com/capabilities/sandboxed-tools.md): Sandboxed tool execution via WebAssembly (wasmtime)
- [Trace Commons](https://docs.ironclaw.com/capabilities/traces.md): Optionally contribute redacted agent traces and earn credit

##### Memory

- [Persistent Memory](https://docs.ironclaw.com/capabilities/memory/memory.md): Your agent's durable, searchable long-term memory system
- [Identity Files](https://docs.ironclaw.com/capabilities/memory/identity.md): Files injected into the LLM system prompt to give the agent persistent identity

##### Routines

- [Cron Routines](https://docs.ironclaw.com/capabilities/routines/cron.md): Schedule recurring tasks with cron expressions
- [Heartbeat System](https://docs.ironclaw.com/capabilities/routines/heartbeat.md): Periodic checks and execution
- [Reactive Routines](https://docs.ironclaw.com/capabilities/routines/reactive.md): Event-driven and webhook-triggered automation

##### Jobs

- [Jobs & Parallel Execution](https://docs.ironclaw.com/capabilities/jobs/jobs.md): Parallel job scheduling and the job state machine
- [Self-Repair & Stuck Jobs](https://docs.ironclaw.com/capabilities/jobs/self-repair.md): Automatic detection and recovery of stuck jobs

### Channels

- [Overview](https://docs.ironclaw.com/channels/overview.md): Reach your agent from a messaging app
- [Slack](https://docs.ironclaw.com/channels/slack.md): Talk to your agent in Slack channels and direct messages
- [Telegram](https://docs.ironclaw.com/channels/telegram.md): Interact with your agent through Telegram

### IronHub

- [Overview](https://docs.ironclaw.com/hub/overview.md): The official catalog of installable tools and skills
- [Installing skills & tools](https://docs.ironclaw.com/hub/installing.md): Install skills and tools from the IronHub catalog
- [Contributing](https://docs.ironclaw.com/hub/contributing.md): Submit your own skills and tools to the IronHub catalog

### API

- [Responses API](https://docs.ironclaw.com/api/responses.md): OpenAI-compatible Responses endpoint backed by the full IronClaw agent loop

### Extensions (Tools)

- [Overview](https://docs.ironclaw.com/extensions/overview.md): Extend your agent with built-in and external tools

#### Built-in Extensions

- [File Handling](https://docs.ironclaw.com/extensions/file-tools.md): Let your agent read and write files in the local filesystem
- [GitHub](https://docs.ironclaw.com/extensions/github.md): Let your agent access GitHub
- [MCP Servers](https://docs.ironclaw.com/extensions/mcp.md): Connect Model Context Protocol servers to extend IronClaw
- [Web Access](https://docs.ironclaw.com/extensions/web-search.md): Let your agent search the web and read pages
- [Shell Commands](https://docs.ironclaw.com/extensions/shell.md): Execute shell commands with environment scrubbing and injection detection

##### Google

- [OAuth Setup](https://docs.ironclaw.com/extensions/google/oauth-setup.md): One-time setup for any Google extension in IronClaw
- [Gmail](https://docs.ironclaw.com/extensions/google/gmail.md): Let your agent read, send, and manage your Gmail messages
- [Calendar](https://docs.ironclaw.com/extensions/google/calendar.md): Let your agent manage your Google Calendar
- [Docs](https://docs.ironclaw.com/extensions/google/docs.md): Let your agent create and edit Google Documents
- [Drive](https://docs.ironclaw.com/extensions/google/drive.md): Let your agent manage files and folders in Google Drive
- [Sheets](https://docs.ironclaw.com/extensions/google/sheets.md): Let your agent read and write Google Spreadsheets
- [Slides](https://docs.ironclaw.com/extensions/google/slides.md): Let your agent create and edit Google Presentations

### Tutorials

- [How to implement a Reborn tool extension](https://docs.ironclaw.com/extensions/building-a-tool.md): A Reborn-only implementation guide for IronClaw extension tools
- [How to build a channel](https://docs.ironclaw.com/channels/building-a-channel.md): Build a WASM messaging channel that plugs into IronClaw

#### How to host IronClaw on...

- [DigitalOcean Droplet](https://docs.ironclaw.com/infrastructure/droplet.md): Host IronClaw on a DigitalOcean Droplet
- [Google Compute Engine](https://docs.ironclaw.com/infrastructure/google.md): Host IronClaw on a Google Compute Engine VM
- [Amazon EC2](https://docs.ironclaw.com/infrastructure/amazon.md): Host IronClaw on an Amazon EC2 Instance
